name: Computer Use Guard
description: Claude Code PreToolUse hook for mcp__computer-use__request_access: denies shell-equivalent apps (terminals, IDEs, Docker), Finder, System Settings, credential stores, remote-control apps, clipboardRead and systemKeyCombos. App names are Unicode and path normalized and matched exactly; fails closed on a missing python3, bad payload or internal error. Self-contained (python3 stdlib).
author: Lucas Santana

pt-BR.name: Guarda de Computer Use
pt-BR.description: Hook PreToolUse do Claude Code para mcp__computer-use__request_access: nega apps equivalentes a shell (terminais, IDEs, Docker), Finder, Ajustes do Sistema, cofres de credenciais, apps de controle remoto, clipboardRead e systemKeyCombos. Nomes de apps são normalizados (Unicode e caminho) e comparados exatamente; falha fechado se faltar python3, o payload for inválido ou houver erro interno. Autocontido (stdlib do python3).
